findings.message: 1 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 1440px: "Yourcareer,reasonedintheopen." → 3 lines (1 words, 96px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 36px or less.

findings.message: 5 headline(s) switch typeface or to italic mid-line (the "one italic serif word" move).
findings.fix: Set the whole headline in one face. Emphasis comes from the words.

findings.message: 6 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "CAREEROS 2.0 • REASONING ENGINE" above "Yourcareer,reasonedintheopen."; "01 — TRACE" above "Every recommendation has a path you can "; "02 — GAPS" above "Distance to the role, measured."; "03 — COMMAND" above "Say what you want. It figures out how."; "LIVE DEMO STUDIO" above "Try the Intelligence Layer"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: Monospace type outside code: JetBrains Mono — e.g. "C", "careeros", "REASONING", "GAPS"
findings.fix: Set it in the text face. Monospace is for literal code inside <pre>/<code> only.

findings.message: Decorative index numbers: "01 — TRACE", "01", "02", "03", "02 — GAPS", "03 — COMMAND"
findings.fix: Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.

findings.message: 11 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "CAREEROS 2.0 • REASONING ENGINE", "✓ PARSE", "✓ EXTRACT", "✓ MATCH").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: Emoji in the page: ✓
findings.fix: Remove. Use words or real imagery.

findings.message: 2 gradient fill(s): div.pointer-events-none.absolute → linear-gradient(to right, lab(100 0 0 / 0.09) 1px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 1px), linear-gradient(lab(100 0 0 / 0.09)  | div.pointer-events-none.absolute → linear-gradient(to right, lab(100 0 0 / 0.09) 1px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 1px), linear-gradient(lab(100 0 0 / 0.09)
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 5 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: button.rounded-md.bg-[var(--signal)] → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0 | div.relative.overflow-hidden → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0 | div.overflow-hidden.rounded-lg → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: 15 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): header.fixed.inset-x-0 1440px | section.relative.pt-32 1440px | div.flex.items-center 644px | div.border-t.border-[var(--border-default)] 644px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: 14 boxes drawn with a 1px outline.
findings.fix: Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.

findings.message: Yellow-cream background (text #f4f0e7).
findings.fix: Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.

findings.message: Low-contrast text: "© 2026 CareerOS Inc. All rights reserved" 4:1 needs 4.5:1
findings.fix: Darken or lighten the text colour.

findings.message: 3 typefaces in use (Geist, JetBrains Mono, Instrument Serif).
findings.fix: Two at most.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Body text is 12px (the size most of the running text is set in).
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px. Map small sizes from blueprints onto your body step.

findings.message: The running text is a soft grey on its ground (6.3:1).
findings.fix: Set body copy in the full ink (7:1 or more). Keep the muted ink for secondary notes; pages read thin and unfinished when everything is grey.

findings.message: Only 0 picture(s) on the page (0 photographs, footage or raster images, 0 interface fragments). Drawings in SVG do not count.
findings.fix: Find real pictures of the subject's world with scripts/assets.mjs (photographs, archival images, maps, engravings, footage), download them to assets/ and give them room: a hero picture, one per section that has a subject, a full-width band. At least four, usually six to twelve.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: 61 text blocks under 13px.
findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: The margins differ: 168px on the left, 185px on the right, at 1440px.
findings.fix: Put the navigation and the content on one pair of margins; check for padding on one side only, a scrollbar gutter, or a header on another inset than the page.

findings.message: Left-aligned text starts at 11 different lines (24px, 49px, 112px, 146px, 289px, 313px, 348px); the three most used hold only 58% of it.
findings.fix: Pick two or three anchor lines from the grid and start every heading and paragraph on one of them.

findings.message: 2 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 390px: "Yourcareer,reasonedintheopen." → 3 lines (1 words, 48px); "Stop guessing. Start reasoning." → 3 lines (4 words, 48px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 24px or less.

findings.message: The h1 is a bare name ("Yourcareer,reasonedintheopen.") and nothing else on the first screen says what this is.
findings.fix: Keep the name if it leads, and give the line under it (18px or more) the plain words: what it is, for whom, where or when. In the study of 97 Sites of the Day, first screens that named nothing lost usability and content points.
